title: KanalyzerSettings
description: Settings namespace `kanalyzer` for the standalone dsh-kanalyzer plugin. This plugin knows nothing about pbfuzz. Design rule: when pbfuzz drives kanalyzer the user must NOT have to change anything here — the defaults are sufficient, and pbfuzz passes the per-run inputs (bitcode, targets, entries) explicitly rather than reading `standalone`.

install.description: Where KAMain comes from. The source is NOT vendored: the Build button starts an agent that clones and builds it, resolving dependencies itself.

llvmPrefix.description: LLVM installation to build against; empty means auto-detect. KAMain needs LLVM 10–16 (it uses APIs removed in 17) and 14 is the verified version, so detection prefers /usr/lib/llvm-14.

wllvmBinDir.description: Optional override for the directory holding the `wllvm`, `wllvm++` and `extract-bc` executables, prepended to PATH for a `wllvm` prepare build. Empty means use whatever the last self-test discovered (`status.wllvmBinDir`), else the host PATH.

defaults.description: Default KAMain runtime options for standalone `/kanalyzer analyze` runs. A caller that passes its own options overrides these per call.

verbose.description: Must be ≥1 in practice: KAMain exits 0 whether or not it found the target, so the only way to tell success from a silent no-op is to parse verbose stderr and inspect the outputs.

useTypeBasedCallGraph.description: true = signature-based call graph (what the Magma pipeline used); false = TyPM/MLTA, more precise and much slower.

dumps.description: Which KAMain dumps to produce. Note the two paired dumps are each written only when both files of the pair are requested.

timeoutSec.description: Large projects are slow — openssl/php runs produce multi-GB outputs — so every analysis is a job with a timeout and a cache.

prepareMode.description: Mode used when a `kanalyzer_prepare` call omits `mode`. `wllvm` wraps the compiler and survives build systems that drop or override LDFLAGS, so it handles large projects; `lto` is the faster path for small or single-file projects whose build honours $CFLAGS/$LDFLAGS. `wllvm` requires `program`.

standalone.description: Inputs for running `/kanalyzer analyze` by hand with no caller. UNUSED when pbfuzz drives kanalyzer.

status.description: Read-only in the card; written by the host through `settings.update()` after a build or doctor run. This is the only channel back to the card — there is no push.

lastWllvm.description: Verdict of the wllvm leg of the last self-test.

wllvmBinDir.description: Directory holding wllvm/wllvm++/extract-bc, as discovered by the last self-test. Host-written; `install.wllvmBinDir` overrides it when set.
